text_block_list.text:
Having unleashed the ultimate racing 
magic, Sweep Tosho felt satisfied with 
racing for now and began studying an 
entirely different kind of magic.

Meanwhile, rumors circulate about an 
Umamusume who contested the Triple Tiara, 
only to step away from racing after 
running alongside Kawakami Princess 
following an injury recovery.

Upon closer listening, the real reason was 
that watching the Takarazuka Kinen made 
her despair over the gap between herself 
and the others. "If you get hurt and have 
to rest, you'll be left in the dust by 
everyone else."

Sweep Tosho bristles with frustration at 
her classmate for being trapped by 
conventional common sense. Breathing 
heavily with indignation, she resolves to 
cast magic on her.

Setting her next goal on the "Tenno Sho 
(Autumn)," she also asked her special 
rival, Zenno Rob Roy, to enter the race.
